sources.title: Public merchant intro confirms Havelock II address
sources.notes: Own managed headless browser read the public intro. The text genesis.vegan.restaurant.sg links to Instagram and is not a separate merchant domain. No login attempted.

sources.title: Havelock II islandwide delivery public initial HTML
sources.notes: Twelve food rows in one category. Initial HTTP 200 snapshot retained; later own managed browser demanded human verification. No bypass. Generic partner descriptions were excluded because several contradict the merchant vegan identity.

sources.title: Havelock II local delivery public initial HTML
sources.notes: Nine food rows in two categories. Initial HTTP 200 snapshot retained; later own managed browser demanded human verification. No bypass. Same-name overlap with islandwide is preserved as separate channel evidence.

sources.title: Public Genesis storefront with Havelock II delivery wording
sources.notes: HTTP 200 initial HTML and managed headless browser show one Items category with no food rows. Name and Havelock II wording match, but no precise street address is supplied here, so exact branch identity relies on the merchant Facebook intro and partner listings.

sources.title: Storefront-linked Items category explicitly returns No results
sources.notes: Own managed headless browser opened the public category linked by the storefront. HTTP 200; visible text Items / No results. No extra food rows available here.

sources.title: Previously linked phone-ordering route
sources.notes: Redirect target returned HTTP 404. This is a broken route, not evidence that the venue has no menu.

branches.name: Genesis Vegan Restaurant (Havelock II)
branches.notes: One current branch verified. Two saved delivery menus contain 21 source rows and 14 distinct names; seven names overlap with matching prices. This is not proof of the complete rotating in-store menu. Public Take App storefront has an empty Items category.
